snippet.title: Turbo Trivia - Trivia for the Whole Family!
snippet.description:
The fast-paced game that will drive you nuts!
Designed for players aged 6 and up, Turbo Trivia puts knowledge and reflexes to the test in a high-energy electronic trivia experience. With over 1,500 age-adapted questions, the game challenges players to respond in just 2 seconds per round, keeping the pace thrilling and intense. As players progress, questions become increasingly difficult, rewarding quick thinking. Correct answers earn points and unlock new levels. An added twist lets players challenge opponents they believe answered incorrectly. A successful challenge scores a point and eliminates the opposing player, adding a strategic layer to the competition.
After the first game, players can choose their response time from 1 to 5 seconds, tailoring the intensity to their preference. Turbo Trivia is perfect for fast-paced multiplayer competition!

Buy Turbo Trivia - https://ultrapro.com/products/turbo-trivia

snippet.title: Pokémon Trainer Ultimate - Test your Pokémon Knowledge!
snippet.description:
Pokémon Trainer Ultimate introduces a new way to play, allowing players to think of a Pokémon and answer a series of questions as the electronic game identifies the correct one and displays it on a built-in LCD screen. Designed for one to four players ages 6 and up, with both solo and multiplayer quiz options, the game features all 151 Pokémon from the Kanto region. It offers approximately 15 minutes of gameplay per round and allows players to scroll through their collection and track missing Pokémon, building their expertise over time. 
Coming soon on August 1st!

Buy Pokémon Trainer Ultimate - https://ultrapro.com/products/pokemon-trainer-ultimate

snippet.title: Magic Tim - The Mind-Reading Animal Expert Game!
snippet.description:
Guess, learn, and play!
Magic Tim is a screen-free, interactive voice-recognition toy for ages 4 and up, designed to spark curiosity and active play. With over 400 animals to guess, Magic Tim’s lively personality delivers a rich and engaging experience that builds memory, listening skills, and deductive reasoning. The game features two modes: a Guessing Game where Magic Tim literally “reads kids’ minds” by guessing the animal they are thinking of, through simple yes/no/I don’t know questions, and an Animal Sound Quiz that challenges players to recognize animal authentic sounds, playable solo to beat a personal high score or competitively with up to four players.

Buy Magic Tim - https://ultrapro.com/products/magic-tim
